scientific_integrity: Six-vertex support profiles and all smaller connected-graph classes are exhaustively reconstructed by standalone standard-library code. Published graph rigidity is invoked as a stated external theorem; no independent audit or external certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Minimality is among connected graphical class-two Lie algebras only. Graph-derived nonisomorphism uses odd characteristic; equality of distributions holds also in characteristic two. Symbolic support-profile equality proves the universal enumerator identity; finite-field tests only corroborate it. The general all-tuple enumerator was known previously and is not claimed as new. Specialized literature covering the exact sharp collision may remain unidentified.
title: A smallest-dimensional universal centralizer-spectrum collision among connected graphical Lie algebras
